about.title: About Me
headline: I am a software
developer working across
the entire full stack.
paragraphs: Computer Engineering student (8th semester) with real-world experience building backend solutions in Python and Odoo, and knowledge in frontend (React) and mobile (Flutter, Kotlin).
I focus on solving real business problems before writing code, and ensuring that every part of the system—from the database to the interface—works as expected.
about.subtitle: Modern full-stack applications & Odoo developer.

experience.title: Experience
experience.subtitle: Full Stack Developer in training, with hands-on experience in web and mobile projects (Android/Flutter).

ricardo_teran.description: During my role as a developer, I focused on creating and maintaining solutions within Odoo. I developed a module from scratch to manage customized manufacturing processes for a tinting company, and I built custom reports for business data management. Additionally, I worked directly on the Point of Sale (POS) module, where I helped repair and stabilize the system integration with fiscal printers, ensuring the continuity of the client's operations.

ucla.description: I designed and developed multiple software projects as part of my university education, applying concepts of software architecture, databases, and full-stack development. I worked on web solutions and mobile applications with microservices architectures and design patterns, strengthening my technical judgment in scenarios with changing requirements, just like in real-world industry projects.
